notes.title: Major Update 1.5.0
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29773765/3d06d4e0ec9771349f213e71b79104f2d2be157d.png

Hi there!
Today we prepared big major update which include:

Multiplayer PvP game mode now is open! Current status beta!
Added Alien biome which include core base, ships, towers.
Added two new ship - "Spark" and "Phantom".
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29773765/000e6db3612577f0d52d0b86127c8eae3e825eb4.png
Added two new weapon - R (Rifle gun), V (Vertex gun).
Added dozens of new SFX.
Change ship balance for speed, fire rate, shield.
Reduced required number of Score for opening new ship.
Optimize and improve for all particle FX.
We improved light in the game, now all objects have much more receive light. 
In general rendering objects looks much better than before.
Fixed some minor bugs.


Thanks to all who play in our game!

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29773765/afd81f05820897d8bf7759a7b2919bf91de2bd57.png
欢迎！

This update includes:

Has be added new languages Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional.
Improved mouse control. LB - fire, RB - special fire. Added stylized cursor. 
Improved base characteristics for all Ships. More armor, more magnetic radius, etc.
Reduced enemy count for one group.
Some minor fix.

Thanks to all who playing the game! 
Stay tuned!
[spoiler]Next update will be include...
PvP Multiplayer Arena. 
New Ships. 
New enemy Biomes. 
New Bosses. 
And tons of new enemies. 
This will be coming soon (in this month) ;)
[/spoiler]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29773765/819d623f8b4f7f4ca52243702a51738d0fbbdae8.png

Hello friends!

This update includes:

Mouse support for all GUI elements.
Added two new groups enemies - Alien starting after 6 waves.
Added weapon modules inside home biome. 
Added some new design elements in enemy base.
Now acceleration fx inherits the color of the ship. This is designed to emphasize the individuality of your ship. 
Added some new SFX.
Update attack for Orbit ship.


At now our team is working on the big update which be included PvP multiplayer game mode and many new content. Please share this news and stay tuned ;)

Thanks to all who play in our game!

notes.title: Hot Fixes!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29773765/6c391408c773ea3aca45ad8fdab72315d508f368.png

Hi there!
With this update we fix all known issues at now.
So this list includes:

Fixed bug with freeze timer, after player Ship leaves enemy base biome.  
Fixed the black screen freeze after restart button. 
Fix bug with the advent of ships Tanks after 6 waves. 
Fixed some samples of sound that were played in Mute mode.
Fix bug with locked 60 FPS. Now game may working up to 200 FPS.
Added the sound of a single attack from the ship Nerv.
Added ricochet sound of shots.
On the home base screen, the camera is remote by 20%. This provides a complete overview of the home base at the time of the enemy attack.
Increased the number of ammo for A, B, C, G, H, L, M, S, W of the secondary weapon. Yay, yay!ːsteamhappyː


Thanks to players #Darkness and #humans mass extinction, to help us identify this bugs.

We are continue working for adding some new features.
Thanks to all who play in our game!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29773765/566d41004e573291893cfb13e625edbb09b1d323.png
- Fix gamepad identity bug, when you start playing on keyboard. 
Thanks to player Darkness for detection this bug!

- Now meteorites throw resources when colliding with a player Ship. Previously, meteorites did not throw away resources when they collided with the player's ship.

- Fix  alignment Player names in leaderboard in the Top Player menu.

- Now in the start game are visible keyboard and gamepad key binding control. Earlier it was shown only once per game.

- Fix some minor bug.

Thanks for playing our game!

notes.title: Hot upgrade 1.0.1!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29773765/1761edc321d5acc888e23e8fc94f88e96416edbf.png
- Add Wave 0. It is wave with special, basis learning gameplay. Destroy enemies, enter to base, upgrade ship. That basic principle to this game.

Thanks for playing our game!
